# Flip Clock (`flipClock`)

A split-flap clock whose flaps really fall, with light and shadow.

- Type: scene (draws its own image; put it first)
- Reacts to: clock
- Cost: medium (~3.4 ms/frame at 5K on a Pro GPU)
- Built-in styles: Flip Clock, Ivory Flip

## Params

| key | label | kind | range / options | default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `face` | Typeface | menu | 0 Grotesk · 1 Rounded · 2 Serif | 0 (Grotesk) |
| `h24` | 24-Hour | toggle | 0 / 1 | off |
| `seconds` | Seconds | toggle | 0 / 1 | off |
| `date` | Date | toggle | 0 / 1 | on |
| `size` | Size | slider | 0.5 … 1.25 | 1 |
